class.name: DefaultBullet
class.brief_description: [color=green](User creatable)[/color] The DefaultBullet node is primarily used to create very basic flying bullets. Provides basic bullet firing functionality and collision handling.
class.description:
[DefaultBullet] is a bullet node that inherits from [Bullet] and adds basic firing functionality.
[b]Movement Modes[/b] • [code]MOVEMENT_VELOCITY[/code]: Velocity-based movement (continuous motion) • [code]MOVEMENT_TWEEN[/code]: Tween-based movement (smooth animation)
[b]Automatic Collision Management[/b] • Automatically detects sprite size to set collision area • Fine-tune collision area through [member collision_margin] • Supports various sprite node types (Sprite2D, AnimatedSprite2D, TextureRect, etc.)
[b]Example (GDScript)[/b] [codeblock] extends DefaultBullet
func ready(): # Bullet configuration damage = 15 collision_margin = 2.0 TweenTrans = Tween.TRANS_SINE TweenEase = Tween.EASE_OUT
# Immediate fire (velocity-based) fire(Vector2(100, 100), MOVEMENT_VELOCITY, 200.0)
func create_delayed_pattern(): # Delayed firing pattern (tween-based) queue_fire(1.0, Vector2(200, 0), MOVEMENT_TWEEN, 150.0) queue_fire(2.0, Vector2(0, 200), MOVEMENT_TWEEN, 150.0) queue_fire(3.0, Vector2(-200, 0), MOVEMENT_TWEEN, 150.0) [/codeblock]
[b]Notes[/b] • [member sprite_path] and [member collision_path] must be set. • [member collision_path] must point to a [CollisionShape2D] node. • When using [method queue_fire], if an existing tween is running, it will fire after completion.
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

method.name: fire
method.description:
Fires the bullet immediately. [param target] is the target position, [param movement_type] is the movement method. [param speed] determines the movement speed or tween duration.
[b]Velocity-based:[/b] speed is movement speed in pixels/second (doesn't stop) [b]Tween-based:[/b] speed calculates tween time using distance/speed formula

method.name: queue_fire
method.description:
Fires the bullet after a delay. [param delay] is the delay time in seconds. If an existing tween is running, the delay starts after completion.
Sequential [method queue_fire] calls can create consecutive firing patterns.

members.member: The margin value for the collision area. The collision area size is determined by subtracting this value from the sprite size. Larger values result in smaller collision areas.
Path to the [CollisionShape2D] node for collision detection. The [RectangleShape2D] of this node is automatically adjusted to match the sprite size.
Current target position. Read-only. Automatically set when calling [method fire] or [method queue_fire].
The [Tween] node that controls the bullet's tween animation. Used in [code]MOVEMENT_TWEEN[/code] mode.
The transition type of the tween animation. Used in [code]MOVEMENT_TWEEN[/code] mode. Default: [code]TRANS_QUAD[/code]
The easing type of the tween animation. Used in [code]MOVEMENT_TWEEN[/code] mode. Default: [code]EASE_IN_OUT[/code]

signal.name: tween_finished
signal.description: Emitted when tween movement is completed. Only occurs in [code]MOVEMENT_TWEEN[/code] mode.

constants.constant: Handles continuous movement using [method CharacterBody2D.move_and_slide]. Suitable for bullets that move at a constant speed.
Animation-based movement mode using tweens. Suitable for bullets requiring complex paths or acceleration/deceleration effects. Controlled through [member velocity_tween].
